title: Installation
text: Requires PHP >= 8.0 with openssl and zlib. composer require erikwang2013/messaging-php; no broker SDK or extension needed.

title: Framework auto-registration
text: Laravel ThinkPHP webman Hyperf Yii2 and Yii3 discover and register the package through their own Composer mechanisms; no manual config copy or component registration.

title: Redis Streams quick start
text: publish receive ack consume consumer group PEL XAUTOCLAIM example and notes.

title: NATS Core subscribe first
text: Core NATS delivers only to existing subscriptions; call receive first, ack and reject are unsupported, use JetStream for persistence.

title: Framework integration
text: Registration and usage for Laravel ThinkPHP webman Hyperf Yii2 and Yii3, with links to each framework guide.

title: Driver support matrix
text: 20 driver names across 13 protocol stacks, P1-P5 phase status and ack requeue delay consumer group capabilities.

title: Development and testing
text: composer test phpstan cs, 739 tests and 2661 assertions, PHPUnit 9.6 on PHP 8.0 and PHPUnit 10 on PHP 8.1-8.5.
